findings.title: Required old-owner conversion release gate cannot execute without retained old state
findings.observed: With the exact accepted #868 old binary supplied, the ignored release-gate test exits 101 before exercising candidate behavior because ISSUE872_OLD_STATE is required.
findings.impact: The complete conversion/recovery denominator and finite recovery gate remain not proven.
findings.scope_boundary: The passing retained #872 validator and current-candidate conversion suites remain valid corroboration, but neither substitutes for this gate.
findings.recommended_disposition: Restore an authenticated portable old-state fixture or repair the owning harness, then rerun this exact gate.

findings.title: Prepared-start timing does not measure an OS-cold cache
findings.observed: The exact frozen candidate passed three alternating warm-host samples, but the retained conditions explicitly say no cache reset and no OS-cold measurement.
findings.impact: The OS-cold prepared-start gate remains not proven.
findings.recommended_disposition: Execute the declared measurement on an authenticated cold host or with a reviewed cold-cache protocol.

findings.title: Avoidable retry reduction lacks a comparable baseline denominator
findings.observed: The candidate journey retains 35 attempts, but no same-corpus predecessor retry denominator was executed.
findings.impact: The claimed 50 percent retry reduction cannot be calculated.
findings.recommended_disposition: Run the same journey against the accepted predecessor and classify equivalent expected denials before comparing avoidable retries.

findings.title: Issue #873 evidence PR CI is not observed
findings.observed: The frozen source candidate CI is green, but this evidence-only branch has not been published and therefore has no PR CI result.
findings.impact: The issue-specific aggregate CI gate remains not proven.
findings.recommended_disposition: Observe required checks after authorized publication.

findings.title: Independent exact-head review of the remediated evidence is not observed
findings.observed: The prior review produced remediation findings; no independent review result exists for the remediation commit yet.
findings.impact: The exact-head review gate remains not proven.
findings.recommended_disposition: Run an independent evidence review at the remediation commit and retain its disposition.

findings.title: Prepared-start artifact originally measured non-frozen candidate bytes
findings.observed: The replaced artifact used candidate BLAKE3 7bf9bd57 instead of frozen installed BLAKE3 c6d7c79a.
findings.resolution: The harness now verifies SHA-256, places the exact frozen binary in the isolated candidate slot, rejects mismatched sample digests, and retained three candidate samples with BLAKE3 c6d7c79a.

findings.title: Replay scripts embedded machine and operator paths
findings.resolution: Replay paths are derived from the repository or supplied through named environment inputs; authored summaries use logical references.

findings.title: Scorecard used statuses outside pass, fail, and not_proven
findings.resolution: All scorecard gates now use only pass, fail, or not_proven; finite recovery, evidence PR CI, and exact-head review are not_proven.
